definition: a successful stroke of the bat in baseball
description: In a grassy back garden ringed by a wooden fence, a young man in a cap sets up over a coloured ball balanced on a batting tee, swings a blue aluminium bat and sends the ball flying high over the lawn. The camera follows the ball into the grey sky, and he stands watching where it lands among the other balls scattered on the grass.
transcript: Watch him ball. Whoa, watch him hit the ball.
